notes: Four adapter-owned schema-valid FOMs exercise a variant range resolved after modules merge. Public Create accepts a compatible range extension, rejects a second named alternative assigning an enumerator inside that range, and accepts a non-extendable variant with explicit members plus HLAother. The Lab table candidate has broad clause-4 provenance (RL-049); the Annex C continuation has broad clause-7 export metadata despite visible C.3 context (RL-050). Create acceptance does not expose the internal HLAother complement set or prove all range-order and merge rules. Java provider runtime, interoperability, and conformance remain unverified.
